snippet.title: Idle Pixel Fantasy - Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3916620/Idle_Pixel_Fantasy/

Recruit hard-working helpers and magical creatures that automatically collect gold and crystals. Unlock new levels, invest in stronger units, and work your way up to the powerful dragon boss at the top.
A relaxing pixel-style idle clicker!
